Enum Class StateActions

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<StateActions>
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.model.state.StateActions
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<StateActions>, Constable
public enum StateActions extends Enum<StateActions>
Enumeration of all possible actions that players can take during different game states in the Galaxy Truckers game. Each action represents a specific interaction with the game that is available in one or more game states.
